user.title: Set up your Fichero label printer
user.description: Nothing is sent to the printer yet. Without a SwitchBot, switch the printer on by hand: Home Assistant connects as soon as it sees it.

data_description.address: Leave blank to find the printer by its name (FICHERO… or D11s_…).
data_description.switchbot_entity: A switch, button or input button that physically presses the printer's power button. Leave empty if you switch the printer on by hand.
data_description.startup_delay: How long the printer needs after a SwitchBot press before Bluetooth is ready.
data_description.label_length: Physical length of one label along the paper, e.g. 30 for 30 × 14 mm labels.
data_description.offset_mm: Moves everything along the label. Positive values move it to the right (in reading direction), negative to the left. Use it if your printer prints off-centre.
data_description.power_off_on_disconnect: Switch the printer off with the SwitchBot when you disconnect. Only used with a SwitchBot.

init.title: Printer settings
init.description: Changes apply right away; the printer reconnects automatically.

connect.name: Connect
connect.description: Press the configured SwitchBot (if any) and open a Bluetooth session.

disconnect.name: Disconnect
disconnect.description: Close the Bluetooth session and stop reconnecting automatically until the next print. Presses the SwitchBot if configured to.

print_label.name: Print label
print_label.description: Fit text, icons, emoji, QR codes and barcodes on a label and print it, connecting first when needed.

text.name: Text
text.description: Label text. Inline tokens: [mdi:fridge] or [m3o:kitchen] for icons, [qr:text or link] for a QR code, [barcode:12345] for a Code 128 barcode. Emoji are supported.

multiline.name: Multiline
multiline.description: Keep typed line breaks and print each line on its own row, wrapping only lines that would get too small.

save_favorite.name: Save favorite
save_favorite.description: Save label text as a shortcut on the dashboard card.

text.name: Text
text.description: Label text to save, including any tokens.

index.name: Favorite position
index.description: Zero-based position used by the dashboard card.

text.name: Favorite text
text.description: Text value retained for existing automations.

calibrate_gap.name: Calibrate label gap
calibrate_gap.description: Measure the gap between labels again, for a printer that feeds blank labels. Feeds a label or two; switch the printer off and on afterwards.
